Market today: The mood is clearly bearish for tech, driven by a broad "AI selloff" hitting major chip names like Nvidia and AMD, and extending to Asian tech. The S&P 500 is also on a losing streak, signaling wider market weakness. This is a tough environment for your concentrated tech/chip book.

Your holdings: Your leveraged tech/chip ETFs are taking a beating. SOXL is down nearly 80%, MUU over 64%, and SMCI over 45%. Many of your stops are far from current prices, making them ineffective. Remember, margin amplifies these drops significantly.

Watch: Keep a close eye on the broader market's reaction to the S&P 500 losing streak. Also, watch for any signs of stabilization or further weakness in the AI/chip sector.

Bottom line: This is a time for aggressive risk management and protecting capital, especially with your leveraged positions.
plays: SOXL: Your stop at 200 is ineffective with the price at 45.3 and a nearly 80% loss. Re-evaluate your risk tolerance and consider a tighter, more realistic stop or a significant trim.
MUU: Similar to SOXL, your stop at 31.6 is far from the current price of 13.37, with a 64% loss. Adjust your stop or trim to manage this deep drawdown.
SOXS: Given the AI/chip selloff, the scanner's long setup for this inverse semiconductor ETF (entry 61.27-60.69, stop 59.51) could be a tactical play if you expect further weakness.
